items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Can The Market Rally Take Flight? Robinhood, Sandisk, AMD, Moderna Surge Into Buy Areas
items.summary: The stock market showed choppy, mixed weekly action. But Robinhood, Sandisk, AMD and Moderna rallied into buy areas.

items.title: Fairshake Has $193 Million for the Midterms. Which Coin Stands to Gain the Most on November 3?
items.summary: Fairshake is sitting on $193 million to shape the midterms, but one crypto donor contributed for reasons far more personal than the others, betting the entire future of its business on what happens November 3.

items.title: Hyperliquid Surges 18% to New High as Bitcoin Sees 5% Gain. What’s Behind the Divergence?
items.summary: Hyperliquid just shattered its all-time high while Bitcoin barely budged, and the gap between them traces back to a single announcement that carries a $46 million price tag for anyone who wants in.

items.title: Crypto Blew Its Big Moment—and the Blame Game Has Begun
items.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong was at the center of a protracted fight over the role of digital assets in mainstream finance.

items.title: Brian Armstrong Predicts $400,000 Bitcoin Price by 2030. The Forecast Requires 51% Growth Annually: Can It Hold?
items.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong quietly slashed his Bitcoin price target by 60% while keeping his 2030 deadline intact, and the math behind his new number reveals just how narrow the path to getting there actually is.

items.title: XRP ETFs Have Been Frozen at $1.71 Billion. When Will Inflows Reach $2 Billion?
items.summary: XRP ETFs have stalled well short of a key milestone, and three straight weeks of slowing inflows raise a pointed question: was August the peak, or can something still shake fund investors back into action?

items.title: T. Rowe Price's Head Of Digital Assets Says Tokenized Stocks Must Be 'Instantly Fungible,' Agency Rules Can Move Without CLARITY Act
items.summary: Blue Macellari of asset manager T. Rowe Price said agency rulemaking could replace the CLARITY Act and move faster.

items.title: Coinbase Files With CFTC To List US Single-Stock Perpetual Futures, Including AAPL And TSLA Contracts
items.summary: Coinbase’s filing used an Apple contract as its model, which is cash-settled, has no fixed expiration, and would trade from Sunday to Friday.
